Transformation in Progress! 🏗️✨

Huge milestone reached at our W 68th St project in Shreveport!. When we picked this up at auction, it was a blighted property that the city desperately needed to see revitalized.

Today, the vision is becoming reality. 

We are deep into a $7.5M renovation to bring 208 high-quality, modern 2-bed units to a market that is absolutely starving for them.

I am currently restructuring the partnership as we head toward our Q4 2027 completion. I’m looking for one or two strategic partners who want to step into a high-equity position and help us cross the finish line on this 200+ unit "heavy-lift" transformation.

This isn't just about real estate; it's about removing blight and providing quality housing for the Shreveport community.

Interested in the data or the full underwriting?
I’m looking to connect with sophisticated investors who are familiar with the Louisiana market. Drop a "DATA" in the comments or shoot me a DM, and let's jump on a private call to discuss the capital stack and the projected exit.

#ShreveportRealEstate #MultiFamily #ValueAdd #RealEstateInvesting #BlightToBright #OpportunityZone #PropertyDevelopment

We acquired a $7,500,000 14-unit retail center. 

Here’s the capital stack we used for the deal: 
 
Debt: We used two loans 
• We secured a first position lien from a national bank. 
• The loan amount for the property was $6,000,000. 
• The first position lien had 7.02% interest.
• The lien had a 25 year amortization. 
• It had an interest only payment period of 36 months. 
• The loan had a term of 36 months. 

Our second position lien was provided by us, the GP group. 
• The 2nd position lien was for the amount of $1,500,000. 
• The loan had an interest only period of 36 months. 
• The term length of the loan was also 36 months. 
• The interest rate was 10.75%. 

Our LP equity covered the capex for the asset. 

There were 14-units in the retail center. 
↳ With 5 units vacant. 
↳ & 2 units $9/SF+ less than market. 
We needed to execute a value-add plan. 

• The LP investors brought $972,014 for that project. 
• Here was the return profile for those investors: 
• The passive investors received an 8% return, 
↳Until the LP was returned 100% their capital.
